    <!-- Original React application remains unchanged. The animated Earth is a separate background layer. -->
<div id="cc-space-wrap" aria-hidden="true"><canvas id="cc-cosmos"></canvas><canvas id="cc-space-markers"></canvas></div>
<div id="root"></div>
  <script id="cc-cosmos-renderer">
/* Standalone Collectives Earth background. No CDN or framework dependency.
   Embedded NASA/Basemap Blue Marble Earth texture, WebGL fragment shader, with
   2D fallbacks and reduced-motion / mobile / visibility throttling. */
(function(){
'use strict';
const shell=document.getElementById('cc-space-wrap');
const canvas=document.getElementById('cc-cosmos');
const marks=document.getElementById('cc-space-markers');
if(!shell||!canvas||!marks)return;
const mq=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const mobile=window.matchMedia('(max-width: 799px)');
const ctx=marks.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const smooth=t=>t*t*(3-2*t);
const stops={
  x:[[0,.55],[.32,.21],[.64,.78],[1,.53]],
  y:[[0,-.11],[.32,.47],[.64,.50],[1,.46]],
  r:[[0,.88],[.32,.49],[.64,.46],[1,.52]]
};
function sample(st,p){
 for(let i=1;i<st.length;i++)if(p<=st[i][0]){
   let t=clamp((p-st[i-1][0])/(st[i][0]-st[i-1][0]),0,1);
   return st[i-1][1]+(st[i][1]-st[i-1][1])*smooth(t);
 }
 return st[st.length-1][1];
}
// Representative city coordinates supply the original reference's golden radar pings.
// They indicate places globally, not actual staffing/client locations.
const cities=[[14.6,121.0],[40.7,-74],[-33.9,151.2],[51.5,-.1],[35.7,139.7],
 [1.35,103.8],[25.2,55.3],[48.9,2.3],[37.8,-122.4],[28.6,77.2],
 [-23.6,-46.6],[19.4,-99.1],[52.5,13.4],[31.2,121.5],[-1.3,36.8],
 [43.7,-79.4],[13.1,80.3],[30.0,31.2],[-26.2,28.0],[55.8,37.6],
 [22.3,114.2],[39.9,116.4],[41.0,29.0],[6.5,3.4],[50.1,14.4]];
const rad=Math.PI/180;
let cssW=window.innerWidth,cssH=window.innerHeight,p=0,target=0,lastFrame=0,loadedAt=performance.now(),running=false;
let gl=null,prog=null,u=null,tex=null,webglReady=false;
const vertex=`attribute vec2 aPosition;varying vec2 vUv;void main(){vUv=(aPosition+1.0)*.5;gl_Position=vec4(aPosition,0.,1.);}`;
const fragment=`precision highp float;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform vec2 uRes;
uniform vec2 uCenter;
uniform float uRadius;
uniform float uTime;
uniform float uRotation;
uniform float uProgress;
uniform sampler2D uEarth;
#define PI 3.141592653589793
float hash(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}
float noise(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);
return mix(mix(hash(i),hash(i+vec2(1.,0.)),f.x),mix(hash(i+vec2(0.,1.)),hash(i+1.),f.x),f.y);}
float fbm(vec2 p){float a=.5,v=0.;for(int j=0;j<4;j++){v+=a*noise(p);p*=2.07;a*=.52;}return v;}
vec3 rotateY(vec3 v,float r){float c=cos(r),s=sin(r);return vec3(c*v.x+s*v.z,v.y,-s*v.x+c*v.z);}
vec3 rotateZ(vec3 v,float r){float c=cos(r),s=sin(r);return vec3(c*v.x-s*v.y,s*v.x+c*v.y,v.z);}
float stars(vec2 uv){
 vec2 ratio=vec2(uRes.x/uRes.y,1.);
 vec2 cell=uv*ratio*175.;vec2 id=floor(cell),f=fract(cell)-.5;
 float rare=step(.991,hash(id));
 float point=1.-smoothstep(0.,.055,length(f));
 float twinkle=.55+.45*sin(uTime*(1.1+hash(id+19.)*2.4)+hash(id+43.)*8.);
 vec2 cell2=uv*ratio*83.;vec2 id2=floor(cell2),f2=fract(cell2)-.5;
 float point2=(1.-smoothstep(.005,.045,length(f2)))*step(.981,hash(id2+17.));
 return rare*point*twinkle*.73+point2*.34;
}
void main(){
 vec2 uv=vUv;
 vec2 screen=uv*2.-1.;
 float nx=noise(uv*vec2(4.,3.)+uTime*.008);
 vec3 bg=vec3(.013,.019,.039)*(1.-.16*length(screen));
 float blueOrb=exp(-dot((uv-vec2(.82,.74))*vec2(2.2,2.9),(uv-vec2(.82,.74))*vec2(2.2,2.9))*3.0);
 float corner=pow(max(0.,uv.x+uv.y-1.30),2.0);
 bg+=vec3(.019,.045,.142)*blueOrb*.44 + vec3(.045,.075,.2)*corner*(.2+nx*.1);
 bg+=vec3(.4,.53,.83)*stars(uv);
 vec2 pos=(uv-uCenter)*vec2(uRes.x/uRes.y,1.)/max(uRadius,.01);
 float d=length(pos);
 float halo=exp(-pow((d-1.015)*5.3,2.0))*0.12;
 float outer=exp(-pow((d-1.055)*23.,2.0))*.34;
 bg+=vec3(.06,.21,.8)*halo+vec3(.23,.45,.88)*outer;
 if(d<1.012){
   float zz=sqrt(max(0.,1.-dot(pos,pos)));
   vec3 sphere=vec3(pos.x,pos.y,zz);
   vec3 t=rotateY(rotateZ(sphere,.37),uRotation);
   float lon=atan(t.z,t.x)/(2.*PI)+.5;
   float lat=asin(clamp(t.y,-1.,1.))/PI+.5;
   vec3 land=texture2D(uEarth,vec2(fract(lon),lat)).rgb;
   float ndl=dot(normalize(sphere),normalize(vec3(-.66,.4,.63)));
   float daylight=smoothstep(-.31,.46,ndl);
   float ocean=clamp((land.b-max(land.r,land.g))*.95+.25,0.,1.);
   float glint=pow(max(dot(reflect(-normalize(vec3(-.66,.4,.63)),sphere),vec3(0.,0.,1.)),0.),60.)*ocean;
   vec3 surface=land*(.09+.91*daylight);
   vec2 cloudUV=vec2(fract(lon+uTime*.0013),lat);
   float clouds=fbm(cloudUV*vec2(42.,22.));
   clouds=smoothstep(.53,.72,clouds)*.23*daylight;
   surface=mix(surface,vec3(.59,.71,.84),clouds);
   surface+=vec3(.85,.89,.94)*glint*.17*daylight;
   float rim=pow(1.-zz,3.7);
   surface+=vec3(.11,.35,.82)*rim*.76;
   float edge=1.-smoothstep(.992,1.008,d);
   bg=mix(bg,surface,edge);
 }
 bg=bg/(bg+vec3(.12));
 bg=pow(bg,vec3(.94));
 gl_FragColor=vec4(bg,1.);
}`;
function shader(type,src){const sh=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(sh,src);gl.compileShader(sh);
 if(!gl.getShaderParameter(sh,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw Error('GLSL: '+gl.getShaderInfoLog(sh));return sh;}
function startGL(){
 try{
 gl=canvas.getContext('webgl',{alpha:false,antialias:false,depth:false,preserveDrawingBuffer:false,powerPreference:'low-power'})||canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
 if(!gl) return false;
 prog=gl.createProgram();gl.attachShader(prog,shader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,vertex));gl.attachShader(prog,shader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,fragment));gl.linkProgram(prog);
 if(!gl.getProgramParameter(prog,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog));
 gl.useProgram(prog);
 let buf=gl.createBuffer();gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,buf);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Float32Array([-1,-1,1,-1,-1,1,1,1]),gl.STATIC_DRAW);
 let a=gl.getAttribLocation(prog,'aPosition');gl.enableVertexAttribArray(a);gl.vertexAttribPointer(a,2,gl.FLOAT,false,0,0);
 u={res:gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uRes'),center:gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uCenter'),radius:gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uRadius'),time:gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uTime'),rotation:gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uRotation'),progress:gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uProgress')};
 tex=gl.createTexture();gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,tex);
 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.REPEAT);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);
 gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,1,1,0,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,new Uint8Array([15,35,72,255]));
 gl.uniform1i(gl.getUniformLocation(prog,'uEarth'),0);
 let image=new Image();image.decoding='async';image.onload=function(){
 try{gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,tex);gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL,true);
 gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,image);
 gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D);
 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);webglReady=true;
 if(mq.matches)render(performance.now());}
 catch(e){console.warn('Collectives texture fallback',e.message);}
 };image.src='data:image/jpeg;base64,
